nodes.name: Run M1 pipeline
nodes.notes: Runs the locked pipeline: collector → dedup → spam filter → payment gate → paced alerts. Secrets read from project .env at runtime — never stored in n8n (AGENTS.md).

import_notes: v2-compatible rewrite: Execute Command node was removed in n8n v2 → Code node spawns python3 directly.
Error path: Code node throws → execution fails → visible in Executions tab; TG ⚠️ alert sent via curl from inside Code node using project .env values (compliant: secrets not in n8n credentials).
Requires NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=child_process,fs set on the n8n server environment.
